_comment: Poverty farm (user request 2026-11-26, Questy bed: clvl 12, 0 potions, gold 7, six deaths). goldPerMin is the MEASURED pickup gold per minute by area on the Questy bed over 24 h (sum of 'loot: ... gold +N' over minutes in the area, V from docker logs; tiny: gold piles average 2.8). With no healing potion and gold under the kit price the hero farms the best of these whose monster level is at most clvl minus noPotionGap, and walks into no area above that level unless the owner's try anyway is on. Numbers are one hero's, one day (S). noPotionFromLevel: below it the plan's own entry levels rule (a clvl 1 hero with no potion still leaves the camp).

kitFloor._comment: Below this many healing potions (a scroll or not) a hero from this level in Normal enters the first field of its act only: Questy walked into Blood Moor and Stony Field with 0 to 1 potions seven times (invariant field-entry-no-kit) and died in Cave Level 1. The farm and level picks skip every other area until gold buys the kit.

noPortalLean._comment: A hero with no town portal and fewer healing potions than this walks home from the first field only (Questy 2026-11-26: Stony Field, three areas out, burned three potions in a crowd of 24 on the way home). Below the entry life line it also does not pick a new field.
